title: QALPA: Property-guided diffusion modeling for efficient exploration of chemical spaces of flexible molecules
abstract: arXiv:2609.16527v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Exploring the chemical space of flexible molecules remains challenging because the vast number of possible compounds and conformations, together with the increasing cost and limited generalization of 3D generative models for larger and more complex molecules, restrict access to unexplored chemistry. Here, we introduce QALPA ("Quantum-Aware Learning for Property-space Augmentation"), a property-guided generative framework that combines an E(3)-equivariant diffusion model with active learning and efficient quantum-mechanical (QM) methods to iteratively explore targeted QM property manifolds. By coupling generation with physics-based evaluation, QALPA improves molecular sampling and model reliability in sparsely populated regions of chemical space. Our results show that training on complementary QM datasets spanning both small (QM7-X) and large (Aquamarine) drug-like compounds enables accurate molecular generation across a broad size rang

translated_title: QALPA：用于高效探索柔性分子化学空间的性质引导扩散建模
translated_abstract: 探索柔性分子的化学空间仍然具有挑战性，因为可能的化合物和构象数量庞大，加之3D生成模型在处理更大、更复杂分子时成本不断上升且泛化能力有限，这些都限制了对未开发化学领域的探索。在此，我们提出了QALPA（“面向性质空间增强的量子感知学习”），这是一个性质引导的生成框架，它将E(3)等变扩散模型与主动学习和高效的量子力学（QM）方法相结合，以迭代地探索目标QM性质流形。通过将生成过程与基于物理的评估相耦合，QALPA改善了化学空间中稀疏区域的分子采样效果和模型可靠性。我们的结果表明，在涵盖小型（QM7-X）和大型（Aquamarine）类药物化合物的互补QM数据集上进行训练，能够在广泛的分子尺寸范围内实现准确的分子生成。
tldr: QALPA是一个将E(3)等变扩散模型与主动学习及高效量子力学方法相结合的性质引导生成框架，通过物理评估与生成耦合迭代探索量子性质流形，实现了对柔性分子化学空间在广泛尺寸范围内的高效探索与准确生成。
en_tdlr: QALPA is a property-guided generative framework that combines an E(3)-equivariant diffusion model with active learning and efficient quantum-mechanical methods, enabling efficient exploration of chemical spaces of flexible molecules and accurate molecular generation across a broad size range.
